verdicts.reason: A shrinks the three plan cards to unreadable thumbnails: the MONTHLY/FAMILY/YEARLY labels and 'per month' text are illegible. It also reorders them to 6/80/48, so Yearly is no longer the centre highlight, and it crams the subhead and legal text into a cramped right-hand column, so the pricing content is lost. B keeps the cards legible and in their original order, with Yearly highlighted, and gives the CTA a clear spot. Its flaws: the headline is smaller than the prices, so the two compete for attention; the left column (logo, headline, subhead) is tightly packed; and the full-width legal line under the cards is tiny and crowds the bottom edge.
